A perennial bulb with sturdy, broadly lance-shaped grey-green leaves to around 30cm. Fragrant, double yellow, orange to peach flowers with a bronze tinge to the outer petals, fade to an attractive paler shade as they mature and appear in late spring
A perennial bulb to 50cm with pale green, lance-shaped leaves. Flowers, in mid- to late spring, are bright yellow, shading to red at the tips of the petals

A clump-forming perennial, to around 80cm high, with deeply lobed, dark green leaves that are tinted coppery red when young, turning dark bronze as they mature. Slender stems bear pale lilac pink flowers in early summer

An upright, rhizomatous perennial to 1m with large, broad, lance-shaped dark green foliage. Brightly coloured white, orange and yellow flowers, fragrant both day and evening, appear from late summer through to October. One of the most hardy and reliable varieties
A clump-forming perennial to 1m tall with hairless, oblong leaves. Purple, branching stems bear spikes of small, pale lilac flowers in summer and autumn
An attractive Lady Fern growing to around 60cm and displaying red and brown stems with increasingly crested green fronds as the fern matures
An evergreen, perennial grass to 40cm tall, forming a clump of grass-like leaves with white margins and variegation. Good in containers or flower borders
This plant is listed on Schedule 9 of the UK Wildlife & Countryside Act as an invasive, non-native species and is banned from sale. See cultivation notes for further details

Tuberous-rooted perennial to about 1m tall, with dark stems and dark bronze-purple foliage. Fully double flowers, produced from midsummer until the first frosts, have coral-red slightly incurved petals, creating a neat shape about 10cm across

A bushy, clump-forming, tuberous, deciduous herbaceous perennial with dark green leaves. Rich lavender-purple ball-shaped flowers fading to white, with lavender-purple edges, appear from summer through until the first frosts of autumn. Good as a cut flower or in a flower border display

A bushy, clump-forming, tuberous perennial with dark green serrated leaves. Rounded, purple flowers with pales tips and petals that are curved inwards, appear on sturdy, upright stems in July, through until October. Long stems makes this variety good for cutting

A shrub up to 45cm high, up to 90cm when in flower, with evergreen, aromatic, linear, serrated pale green leaves, edged in yellowish cream, and may have spikes of fragrant, pale lavender-blue flowers in summer

alternative_names: rose [Great North Eastern Rose]|Rosa [GNER]|Rosa 'Sir Galahad' white-flowered|Rosa [Great North Eastern Rose]|Rosa 'Hareasy'

description: Bushy rose about 90cm tall, with healthy rich green foliage, and bearing a succession of double, lightly scented golden-yellow blooms from summer to autumn
Compact, bushy rose about 60-75cm tall, with dark green leaves, and lightly scented, classic, loosely cup-shaped velvet-red blooms repeat-flowering through summer into autumn

primary_name: Codonopsis foetens subsp. nervosa from Minshan, Sichuan, China

description: A bushy, rhizomatous tender, evergreen perennial to 60cm tall, with large, evergreen leaves that can exceed 30cm in length. The predominantly silvery leaves have dark edges and veins and a dark red-purple and pink central star
A compact, tender perennial with hairy, strap-shaped leaves and tubular pink flowers borne over a long season speckled and streaked with darker pink to purple over a white to mid-pink background
A compact, tender perennial with dark green, wrinkled, strap-shaped leaves. Ruffle-edged flowers borne over a long period have creamy-white upper lobes and deep ,cherry-pink lower lobes

primary_name: Sinopodophyllum hexandrum from Kangding, Mugecuo Lake, Sichuan, China

description: A deciduous, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped mid-green leaves and sturdy stems producing umbels of trumpet-shaped dark blue flowers in summer and autumn

A compact, clump-forming perennial, up to 60cm high, with leafy, branching stems and dark green foliage. Flowers have orange to yellow petals surrounding a large brown central cone, and are produced from midsummer into autumn

A vigorous but non-invasive, clump-forming bamboo with striped green and brown stems, maturing to dark purple to almost black, and fine, green foliage. It's thin foliage gives a feathered effect, making it ideal for pots and containers and lightly shaded areas of the garden
A very tall, upright and vigorous clump of maroon red stems which fade to lavender purple as they mature and bright green narrow overhanging foliage. Plant in afternoon shade for the best colour
A tough, vigorous, evergreen, clump-forming bamboo with an open, arching habit, pale blue-green stems with reddish sheaths, and narrow, blue-green foliage
Evergreen, clump-forming bamboo producing a tight thicket of thin, bright green upright stems with a hint of blue, maturing to dark red, about 3-4m tall, with fresh green leaves

primary_name: Capsicum annuum var. annuum (Grossum Group) 'Mini Bell Yellow'
Capsicum chinense 'Seven Pod Brain Strain Yellow'
alternative_names: Capsicum chinense 'Seven Pot Brain Strain Yellow'

description: A compact, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing sunny yellow blooms in summer with a prominent central green cone surrounded by overlapping, orange-yellow petals that eventually mature to a bright golden-yellow. Excellent as a cut flower and for attracting pollinators

alternative_names: coneflower [SunSeekers Orange]|Echinacea [SunSeekers In Tanz Bright Orange]|Echinacea 'Apecssior'
description: An attractive, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing vibrant orange blooms with a prominent central orange-brown cone and narrow, downward arching petals. Excellent as a cut flower and for attracting pollinators
A semi-evergreen, upright, bushy shrub with aromatic green foliage and vibrant red lipped flowers on maroon calyces from summer through to autumn.
A tuberous, clump-forming perennial to about 10cm high with rounded, serrated dark green foliage and pale pink, double pom-pom like flowers appearing in spring and early summer

A deciduous, spreading, often multi-stemmed tree to around 3m in height, with a rounded crown and umbrella-shaped habit. Maroon-red, elegant heart-shaped leaves appear in early spring, changing to green with a white margin as they mature. Clusters of pink-purple, pea-like flowers appear on the bare branches before any leaves appear. A great choice for smaller gardens due to its more compact habit and slow growth

A compact, deciduous, dome-shaped tree with small, heart-shaped variegated green and white-splashed leaves which are most predominantly white as they emerge as young foliage. Clusters of pea-like rich-pink flowers appear on the stems, before the leaves in mid spring. Easy to care for and good for smaller gardens, even if grown in a pot or container

alternative_names: downy Spanish snapdragon|Antirrhinum molle var. mollissima

description: A dwarf, bushy deciduous perennial reaching a height of just 40cm, with dark green leaves. Fragrant, mauve-blue, bell-shaped flowers appear from late May through to September. Ideal for pots or at the front of a herbaceous border

An evergreen palm tree unlikely to reach 8m in the UK, with a mature spread of 5m. It produces edible dates of medium size, dark in colour. They are quicker to reach fruiting maturity, than other varieties. The leaves are 2m long, dark green, with many paired leaflets
A deciduous tree with mid-green foliage that turns bright red in autumn; deep pink spring flowers are followed by small, red fruits that persist on the tree well into winter

primary_name: Monarda didyma 'Pardon My Cerise' (Pardon My Series)

description: A compact, early-flowering herbaceous perennial with rounded, deeply lobed grey-green leaves. Slightly cupped, bright pink flowers with darker veining appear in spring through to late summer

A compact, herbaceous perennial with rounded, deeply lobed grey-green leaves. Slightly cupped, bright pink flowers with darker purple veining and a dark purple eye appear in spring through to late summer

An upright, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with deeply divided mid-green leaves. Branched stems bearing compact heads of long-lasting small white flowers, flushed with pink, appear from April through to July
A compact, bushy deciduous perennial with dark green leaves. Blue, pink or white bell-shaped flowers with twisted edges are produced from early summer. This variety does not climb
A bushy perennial, to around 50cm high, with finely divided dark green leaves. Daisy-like flowers, with cream-coloured petals brushed with yellow in the centre, are produced from mid to late summer
A perennial herb, with upright to ascending stems and aromatic, toothed green leaves with a lightly fruity scent. Spikes of small, pale purple flowers are produced at the tips of the stems in summer
A compact, clump-forming deciduous perennial with aromatic grey-green foliage and upright spikes which produce dark blue-purple flowers throughout the summer

A large shrub or small deciduous tree with large, mimosa-like, deep-purple bipinnate leaves which emerge bronze-green. Fluffy rose-pink flower-heads, with prominent stamens, open in summer. Flat bean-like seed pods follow into winter. An exotic-looking tree which is ideal for smaller gardens where space is limited, or in pots and containers

A compact, deciduous rhizomatous perennial with lush, dark green foliage. Erect stems produce bright red flowers from mid summer to early autumn. An ideal variety for pots, containers or a sunny border due to its compact nature
Compact, rhizomatous perennial to about 50cm with mid-green leaves. Orange flowers, yellow at the throat, and with slightly darker speckles, are produced from early summer to early autumn
Compact, clump-forming perennial to around 50cm tall with broad mid-green leaves, and large, bright yellow flowers speckled with orange produced from summer into autumn

Compact, clump-forming perennial, to 50cm tall, with bright green leaves and spikes of large pink flowers from summer to autumn. This stocky and free-flowering variety is good in a container or planted at the front of a border
Compact, rhizomatous perennial to about 50cm with dark bronze leaves. Salmon-red flowers, with some dark pink streaks and speckles, are produced from early summer to early autumn
A compact, rhizomatous perennial to about 50cm, with dark bronze leaves. Tangerine flowers with faint speckles are produced from early summer to early autumn

primary_name: Begonia 'Northern Lights Scarlet Burst' (Northern Lights Series) (T)

description: A compact perennial, usually grown as an annual, with finely divided, dark green leaves and orange flowerheads with yellow centres from summer to autumn

This half-hardy daisy can be used as a bedding or conservatory plant in summer bedding schemes, patio and balcony displays, in containers, window boxes and hanging baskets, but also as a dainty plant for a sunny rock garden. A pretty yet quite tough cut-leaved 'rock daisy' that can thrive in dry, rocky or shallow soils once well established. It produces pretty pale to mid mauve-blue daisy flowers with yellow-green to yellow-gold centres. Blooms profusely in summer and well into autumn if dead-headed. The plant has attractive, fine, deeply-divided mid-green foliage.
A tall, upright, half-hardy annual with attractive palmate leaves and terminal clusters of white flowers in summer and into autumn

A fast-growing, frost-tender perennial, usually grown as an annual, to around 60cm in height, with rigid, thornless, upright stems bearing dark green leaves. Clusters of delicate, pastel rose-pink to white flowers appear from May through to September

A compact, bushy, borderline hardy perennial often grown as an annual. It has small, mid-green, oval, semi-evergreen leaves and bears an abundant froth of large mid-pink, two-spurred flowers in succession from summer to early autumn. Height around 16cm (6in).

A bushy, clump-forming, evergreen to semi-evergreen perennial with leathery, dark green foliage. Single, pink and white flowers with burgundy red centres appear from late winter to early spring. Makes a good patio or container plant or for underplanting

A robust and compact, bushy, half-hardy perennial. Has small lance-shaped, toothed dark green leaves and terminal racemes of scented two-lipped tubular dark purple and yellow flowers with a golden yellow protuberance in the centre from late spring to early autumn.
A compact, bushy perennial to about 25cm, usually grown as a bedding plant. It has small, neat leaves and fragrant, bicoloured, purple and yellow flowers from late spring to early autumn
A semi-trailing perennial grown as an annual, with sticky, rather greyish-green foliage. Purple flowers with a pale green margin are produced from early summer into autumn

primary_name: Petunia [Easy Wave Berry Velour] ('Pas982903') (Easy Wave Series)
Petunia [Shock Wave Coral Crush] ('Pas803824') (Shock Wave Series)

description: A compact, upright perennial, to around 50cm high, with thin, lance-shaped green leaves. Rounded clusters of fragrant white flowers streaked with soft violet-blue are produced in midsummer

A short, stocky variety with flowers appearing in the summer. Petals are a golden yellow with a dark brown centre and dark-orange to brown markings on the base of the petals that look like brush strokes. Ideal for pots or containers and also for smaller gardens.

A vigorous, spreading, short-lived perennial to about 20cmin height and trailing up to 60cm. Normally grown as an annual or biennial, it can be in flower at almost any time of year depending on sowing date. The flat-faced, rounded flowers up to 5cm across come in a mix of two-tone and self-colours, including yellow, white, and several shades of purple

A clump-forming, deciduous, bulbous herbaceous perennial with glossy green strap-like leaves. Clusters of soft green, purple-brown bell-shaped flowers which open from the bottom up, appear on tall, upright spikes in the spring. Seedheads provide interest over winter

A perennial bulb, to around 20cm high, with broad, grey-green leaves. Nodding white flowers are produced in late winter and early spring, sometimes singly but often two to a bulb. Flowers have an olive green ovary, ridged outer petals, and inner petals marked with a square green blotch near the base and an inverted v-shape near the tip
A bulbous perennial to 50cm with green foliage and dark purple frilly flowers which appear from April to May

A perennial bulb with broadly ovate green leaves. This tulip has goblet-shaped flowers with pointed petals, in rich violet purple with narrow dark green flaming on the outer petals. Flowers are produced in late spring, and stand to around 40cm high

A perennial bulb with broadly ovate green leaves. This tulip has cup-shaped flowers, with a pale cream base and deep purple-pink petals, trimmed with a fringed orange margin. Flowers are produced in late spring, and stand to around 55cm high

Tuberous-rooted perennial to about 1-1.2m tall, with mid-green foliage. Giant, 'dinner plate' fully double, slightly ruffled, pale orange flowers flushed yellow, are up to 27cm across, produced from midsummer until the first frosts

A tuberous-rooted perennial to about 90cm, with mid-green foliage. From mid-summer to the first frost produces large (15cm), flamboyant flowers with long, tightly quilled and twisted petals, dark red at the base, shading though pink to white at the tips

A deciduous large shrub or small tree with oval, conspicuously veined leaves up to 17cm long. Clusters of small white flowers in late spring are followed by rounded fruits to 1.5cm in diameter that start green before turning brown
A compact, clump-forming bulbous perennial heritage daffodil to around 15cm in height, with green strap-like foliage. Bright yellow, double layered flowers appear on sturdy stems from March to April

A tuberous-rooted perennial to about 1m, with purple-flushed, dark green foliage, blooming from mid-summer until the first frosts. Single flowers have rather narrow, dark red petals and a dark red central disc opening to dark yellow
A herbaceous perennial, 1.2-1.4m high, with green leaves and miniature cactus flowerheads that are a deep warm pink, from summer until the first frosts in autumn

A compact, bushy, clump-forming, tuberous perennial with dark green serrated leaves. This mini-cactus variety has spikey-petalled, salmon-pink and yellow flowers which appear on sturdy, upright stems from June until the first frosts of autumn

A clump-forming, deciduous, tuberous perennial with dark green leaves and strong, upright stems which produce dusky pink flowers with petals which reflex backwards, and have gold tips. Flowers appear from June until the first frosts. A good variety for exhibiting and for cutting, but if restricting blooms, they may become oversized

primary_name: Buddleja 'Blue Chip Junior' (Lo and Behold Series)
description: Compact, deciduous shrub to 90cm high, with broadly lance-shaped, silvery grey-green leaves, and panicles of fragrant purple-blue flowers from midsummer to early autumn; the Lo and Behold series do not set fertile seed, so will not spread

primary_name: Buddleja 'Pink Micro Chip' (Lo and Behold Series)
description: A compact shrub up to 0.6m high, with deciduous, lance-shaped, grey-green leaves, and panicles of fragrant pink flowers from midsummer to early autumn; the Lo and Behold series do not set fertile seed, so will not spread

A compact, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing highly attractive, fiery, true red blooms with a prominent central brown cone surrounded by slightly drooping ray petals. Long blooming, this variety looks best when planted en masse in the border or used in container displays

A bushy, often short-lived herbaceous perennial with a basal rosette of lance shaped mid-green leaves. From early summer to early autumn flowerheads composed of orange-red 'daisy' blooms with yellow tips are produced on upright stems 30-40cm high

A compact, bushy, relatively short-lived perennial to 30cm, with greyish-green foliage. Large, daisy-like, yellow flowers with an orange flush are borne on upright stems from early summer to early autumn

primary_name: Helleborus (Rodney Davey Marbled Group) [Sally's Shell] ('Epb 12') (Frostkiss Series)
description: A semi-evergreen clump-forming perennial with divided, leathery, marbled foliage and branched stems rising above with dangling cup-shaped shell-pink single flowers pale pink towards the middle and a central boss of yellow stamens in late winter and early spring.

A clump-forming perennial to about 25cm high, forming a mound of lobed, bright green leaves with a silver sheen on the upper surface. Loose sprays of small red flowers are held on slender stems above the foliage in summer

alternative_names: hydrangea [Strawberries 'n' Cream]|Hydrangea macrophylla 'Mak2'|Hydrangea macrophylla [Blackberry Pie] (Flair & Flavours Series)
description: A compact, deciduous shrub to around 100cm in height, with coarsley toothed dark green foliage and strong stems. Dark pink-red and creamy-white lace cap flower heads appear from summer through to autumn. Colours may vary if grown in acidic soil

A compact, bushy perennial to about 25cm, usually grown as a bedding plant. It hassmall, dark green leaves and relatively large, pinky-purple flowers with yellow eyes, from late spring to early autumn

A dwarf deciduous tree of columnar form, reaching 2.5m. It has glossy green leaves which become yellow in autumn. It is self-fertile and its white blossom in spring develops into late-picking green fruit with a flush of red

A vigorous bushy shrub to 1.5m high, with a rounded habit and broadly ovate, coarsely toothed green leaves that turn yellow in autumn. Large, domed, densely packed clusters of flowers are produced on strong stems in summer; flowers open pale yellow green, turn pale pink and develop to deep pink as the season progresses

A deciduous, compact, mound forming shrub with deeply divided golden to acid yellow leaves. Newly emerged leaves are often tinted bronze. It is grown principally as a foliage plant, but in early summer it produces frothy cream-white flowers followed in late summer by clusters of orange-red berries.
A compact, herbaceous perennial to about 50cm in flower, forming a mound of bright green leaves and producing white, pincushion flowers over a long period from early summer to autumn

A miniature, clump-forming deciduous perennial with yellow foliage. Upright stems of lavender-purple flowers appear in the summer. A yellow seedling of Hosta 'Blue Mouse Ears'. Suited to pots and containers rather than the ground
A compact perennial to 30cm tall and 60cm wide with aromatic, bluntly toothed, grey-green leaves. Spikes of deep purple-blue flowers in tiered whorls are produced from summer into early autumn

A semi-evergreen bulbous perennial with a rosette of long, lance-shaped green leaves. Produces dense conical clusters of dark purple buds on upright stems in early summer; these open to a dome shape, bearing up to 100 star shaped, violet blue flowers on delicate purple-tinted stalks

primary_name: Impatiens from China, Darrell Probst collection

description: A compact, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing highly attractive white blooms with a large, prominent, central green cone surrounded by narrow, overlapping, slightly quilled petals. Excellent for cut flowers and attracting pollinators
A compact, slow-growing, clump-forming deciduous herbaceous perennial to around 20cm in height with green foliage and white flowers appearing in the summer

Densely tufted semi-evergreen to evergreen grass about 1.5m tall, with long rhizomes, forming loose, spreading clumps of arching, pale, steel-blue leaves about 60cm long. Produces stiff, upright stems beraing spike-like racemes 35cm long of blue-grey then buff spikelets throughout summer

A compact, rosette-forming, evergreen perennial with spoon-shaped, smooth pale green foliage. The stunning and scented deep purple flowers have a contrasting white center, appearing in the spring and continuing into early summer

primary_name: Veronica 'Atomic Hot Pink Ray' (Atomic Ray Series)

description: A compact, rounded deciduous shrub with upright stems and long, aromatic toothed dark green foliage which is grey-silver underneath. Dark blue fragrant flowers appear from late summer through until the autumn

A compact, deciduous shrub to around 120cm with coarsley toothed dark green foliage and rounded clusters of white mophead flower heads which fade to green with red edges on the petals, appearing from June through to October

A compact, deciduous shrub to around 120cm in height, with coarsley toothed dark green foliage and large, double pink or blue (depending on acidity of soil) star-shaped lace cap flower heads, edged with white, which appear in the summer

A compact, deciduous shrub to 1.2m high, with dark red stems and ovate green leaves that turn reddish purple in autumn. Flowers are produced from early summer, in loose clusters made up of tiny fertile flowers and large, showy sterile ones. Flowers open creamy white, and develop through pale pink to deep pink and lilac by late summer

A bushy deciduous shrub, to around 1.2m high, with an upright habit, sturdy stems and narrowly oval-shaped, deep green leaves with serrated edges. Large conical clusters of small white flowers are produced in mid summer, gradually touched with pink as they mature. Leaves turn red and orange before dropping in autumn
A stunning, compact, deciduous shrub with rich, dark green foliage contrasted against large, highly fragrant, double white blooms in early summer

A rhizomatous perennial forming a mound of heart-shaped, rough, silvery leaves with yellow to greenish veining and edges, each up to 20cm long. Small, blue flowers are borne in sprays above the foliage in spring
A slow-growing dwarf deciduous tree reaching 3m. It has green leaves variegated with cream splashes

A bulbous perennial with whorls of leaves on upright stems to about 1m tall. Flowers, produced in mid- to late summer, are yellow in the centre, spotted with dark red, with recurved petals shading to orange-red at the tips

A vigorous perennial bulb, to around 18cm high, with narrow, grey-green leaves. Nodding, scented white flowers are produced in late winter, with curving outer petals held on a long claw, and inner petals marked with two dark blotches at the tip, sometimes connected together, and a faint green patch in the middle of the petals

A clump-forming perennial to 1m high with dark purple, lance-shaped, hairy leaves. Produces bi-coloured daisy-like flowers on long stems, with petals golden yellow at the edges and rich orange at the centre, from summer to early autumn.
A compact perennial with dark green foliage and slender racemes of small deep purple-blue lipped flowers which have reddish-purple bracts from late spring throughout summer.

primary_name: Phlox paniculata [Adessa Special Deep Purple] (Adessa Series)
description: An erect herbaceous perennial with dark-green lance-shaped foliage and terminal clusters of fragrant tubular purple-violet flowers over a long period of time in summer.
A compact, clump-forming perennial to 50cm tall with dark green foliage and upright stems topped with clusters of scented dark pink to red flowers from summer into autumn

primary_name: Phlox paniculata [Adessa Special Lilac Twist] (Adessa Series)

description: A spreading, evergreen shrub to around 20cm in height, with silvery grey-green leaves. Masses of single, salmon to coral-pink flowers, with a yellow centre appear from May through to September

A compact, clump-forming perennial, 35-40cm high, with lance-shaped, serrated dark green leaves. Long spikes of small, star-shaped pale pink flowers are produced from early summer through to early autumn
An evergreen, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-like mid-green leaves and tall, sturdy stems producing umbels of trumpet-shaped pure white flowers in summer

A clump-forming perennial to around 30cm high, with divided grey-green leaves with felted undersides. Upright stems bear rounded buds covered with papery brown scales, opening at the top to thistle-like flowers with fine purple florets in midsummer. Flowers dry to pale-coloured 'cones' in late summer

A tall, vigorous, hardy, but rare, perennial to around 130cm in height, with dark green foliage. Large, single, daisy-like dark pink flowers with yellow centres and quilled petals appear over a long period from September to the end of November

A vigorous climbing rose to about 3m in height, with healthy, glossy dark green foliage, and bearing sweetly-scented, fully-double, cup-shaped creamy blooms, with a lemon-yellow centre, repeat-flowering from early summer to autumn

A bushy upright rose, about 1.2m tall, with healthy mid-green foliage tinted reddish-purple when young. Scrolled buds open to lightly scented well-formed, fully double, bright red blooms carried on long stems, repeat-flowering from early summer to late in autumn

Vigorous, free-flowering climbing rose about 2.4m tall, with mid-green leaves, and bearing trusses of fully double, loosely cupped, fragrant candy pink blooms, flushed yellow, with irregular flecks and stripes of creamy-white on both sides of the petals, repeat-flowering through summer and autumn

primary_name: Veronica [Dark Blue Moody Blues] ('Novaverblu') (Moody Blues Series)
description: A compact, clump-forming perennial to around 40cm high, with lance-shaped, serrated dark green leaves. Spikes of small, star-shaped deep blue flowers are produced at the tips of leafy stems, from early summer through to early autumn

An upright, bushy rose about 1.2m tall, with dark green foliage and bearing strongly fragrant, large high-centred, dark red blooms to 11.5cm across, opening from large buds, repeat-flowering from early summer to autumn
Almost thornless climbing rose to 2.4m tall, with healthy green foliage and lightly-scented, semi-double, cupped, lilac blooms opening from deep lilac buds, repeat-flowering through summer and autumn
A compact bush rose to 1m high, with abundant glossy, dark green foliage and clusters of lightly scented, rounded double, cherry-red flowers in summer and autumn

A bushy, upright rose to about 90cm tall, with strong purplish stems, pink thorns and healthy bronze-tinted, glossy green leaves. Very fragrant, large, fully double. bright vermillion red blooms with a black edging and occasional white flash flower singularly and in small trusses from early summer onwards

A strong, clump-forming semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial producing ruffled, glossy, dark purple to black foliage with reddish hues. White flowers appear on tall, upright stems above the foliage during the summer
A clump-forming perennial to about 40cm high, forming a dense mound of lobed, reddish pink leaves with a slight silver sheen. Loose sprays of small white flowers appear above the foliage in summer

A hardy, clump-forming, evergreen perennial to a height of 40cm, with a dense mound of lobed leaves that remain lime green all year round. Soft orange flowers are held on slender stems of up to 60cm in May and June

A clump-forming, semi-evergreen perennial, with a trailing habit and lobed, deep purple leaves with a silvery sheen. Slender stems bear clusters of tiny, bell-shaped pink and white flowers from late spring into summer

An evergreen short-lived perennial usually grown as a biennial, with a compact, bushy habit and narrow, silvery dark green leaves. Clusters of fragrant flowers, in soft shades of yellow, orange, pink and purple, are produced at the tips of the stems from spring into summer
A clump-forming herbaceous perennial growing to a height of 35cm with finely-divided, deep purple/green leaves. The single white flowers are veined lilac and bloom from late spring through to summer

A compact, clump-forming, semi-evergreen to evergreen perennial bearing rounded, ruffled, shallowly lobed, red to purple-red leaves and slender, upright stems bearing panicles of small, bell-shaped, white flowers in summer.

A clump-forming, evergreen herbaceous perennial with a neat, compact habit. Masses of ruffled, blue-green foliage, variegated with creamy white to pink as the season progresses, contrasts with long stems of bright coral-red flowers in spring and summer. Ideal for pots and containers or at the front of a border

A strong, vigorous, clump-forming semi-evergreen to evergreen herbaceous perennial producing large, bright red to pink foliage. Small pink flowers appear on tall, upright stems above the foliage during the summer

A hardy and robust, clump-forming, evergreen perennial, to 35cm in height, with a dense mound of rounded, lobed leaves that glow amber all year round. The soft orange flowers are held on slender stems up to 45cm in May and June

A semi-evergreen, clump-forming perennial to around 30cm in height, with semi-glossy leaves which emerge as a metallic pink in spring, darkening to a berry pink, with fantastic dark purple veins. A profusion of small pink flowers are held on slender stems above the foliage, from late spring into summer

A compact, clump-forming, evergreen perennial to about 30cm with lobed, rounded leaves opening yellow-orange and maturing to yellow-green, with darker veins and a silvery sheen. Dark red, upright stems carry spikes of small, yellow-green flowers from late spring to early autumn
A semi-evergreen, upright, bushy perennial with mid-green, small oval fragrant leaves and crimson lipped flowers from summer through to autumn.
A clump-forming perennial with green, aromatic foliage and fragranced bright purple daisy-like flowers with a 'shaggy' appearance around the edges and dark purple centres

A compact, clump-forming perennial to 45cm tall, with lance-shaped, aromatic, dark green foliage. From mid-summer to early autumn each upright stem carries a whorl of two-lipped, tubular, rich red-pink flowers with decorative, purple-flushed bracts and a dark centre

A compact, clump-forming perennial to 45cm tall, with lance-shaped, aromatic, mid-green foliage. From mid-summer to early autumn each upright stem carries a whorl of two-lipped, tubular, light pink flowers with decorative, dark red-flushed bracts and a dark centre

A compact, clump-forming perennial to 45cm tall, with lance-shaped, aromatic, dark green foliage. From mid-summer to early autumn each upright stem carries a whorl of two-lipped, tubular, red-purple flowers with decorative, purple-flushed bracts and a dark centre

An ornamental biennial which flowers in its second year, before setting seed. It has white and maroon florets and attractive feathery leaves. When the flowers are finished, the seedheads remain interesting for many more weeks

A dwarf, deciduous bulbous perennial with strap-like dark green leaves and single stems producing large, fragrant red flowers. Flowers are upward and outward-facing, appearing from June to August

A short-stemmed lily up to 60cm high with dark green foliage and large, upward-facing white summer flowers

A robust and compact, bushy, half-hardy perennial. Has small lance-shaped, toothed dark green leaves and terminal racemes of scented two-lipped tubular white flowers. An upright and bushy herbaceous perennial with attractive, dissected dark green foliage tinged red in spring. Erect stems hold showy, spicily scented, double saucer-shaped very pale pink flowers, fading to white as the flower matures in summer.

A compact, clump-forming penstemon with mid-green leaves. Dusky pink to dark pink flowers with a white throat appear in summer and autumn

A bushy upright, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with lance-shaped somewhat toothed dark green hairy leaves. It produces numerous large buttery yellow, darker butterscotch orange petals towards the base around a brown central cone

A bushy, clump-forming herbaceous perennial to 60cm tall, with lance-shaped, slightly toothed green leaves. A bushy, clump-forming herbaceous perennial to 60cm tall, with lance-shaped, slightly toothed, hairy dark green leaves. Bulbous perennial producing short-lived, strap-shaped mid-green leaves and densely-packed, spherical heads of reddish-purple star-shaped flowers on upright stems about 50- 70cm tall, in late spring as the leaves die down

A bulbous perennial with linear, keeled basal leaves to 30cm long, which smell of garlic. In summer stout stems to 1m produce dense clusters of 20-30 bell-shaped, white flowers, often with pink markings

Bulbous perennial, to 1.2m high, with strap-shaped, clear green basal leaves and, from early to midsummer, rounded umbels, up to 13cm in diameter, of star-shaped purple-blue flowers borne on sturdy, upright stems

An evergreen perennial usually grown as an annual. It has semi-trailing stems and small, simple leaves. Cream flowers with broad, pinky-red stripes are produced over a long period in summer and autumn

A small, perennial corm growing to 8cm tall with long, narrow, dark green leaves marked with a fine, central white stripe. In late winter and early spring produces golden yellow, goblet-shaped flowers streaked with purple on the outside of the petals

A deciduous, bulbous perennial with fleshy, strap-shaped leaves and several, very sturdy stems of large, funnel-shaped pink flowers

Lightly-scented, spider-like flowers range from pale pink to deep red, with lower part of the lip being usually white.
A small, compact shrub to 75cm tall with dark green leaves that are flushed purplish when young, and salmon- to peach-pink flowers from mid-spring to autumn

A compact, tuberous-rooted perennial with rosettes of broadly heart-shaped foliage, with small, silvery markings and wavy edges, appearing from late winter to early summer. Double, creamy-white flowers, with fine, pale purple veining, and purple flushing on the reverse, open from early spring
A bushy, compact, vigorous deciduous shrub with glossy dark green leaves and large, highly fragrant, creamy-white flowers repeat flowering from summer through to autumn. Good disease resistance
A deciduous, perennial climber with dark green leaves. Large, dark red to dark pink flowers with creamy yellow stamens appear from early summer through to early autumn

A vigorous, deciduous climbing perennial with dark green leaves. Abundant, exotic looking purple-blue flowers with a darker reddish-purple central stripe on the petals, dark purple anthers and a silvery sheen appear from July through to September
A deciduous, perennial climber with bright green leaves which turn darker green as they mature. Dark reddish-purple flowers with white anthers appear from June through to September

An attractive, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing vivid yellow blooms with a prominent central pompom surrounded by drooping rays, from Summer through to Autumn. Excellent for container growing and attracting pollinators

An unusual and striking coneflower variety producing clear white blooms with varying degrees of pink-purple radiating from the base of the petals, set against a dark orange central cone. Excellent as a cut flower and for attracting pollinators

A compact, tuberous-rooted perennial with rosettes of broadly heart-shaped, dark bronzy-purple foliage from late winter to early summer. Double, orange flowers, with bronze flushing on the reverse, open from early spring

Compact deciduous climber about 1.5-2m tall, with mid-green leaves, and white flowers to 15cm across, blushed pale purple with pale green bars to the reverse of the six overlapping, pointed sepals, and red-purple stamens, free-flowering all along the stem over a long period from early summer to autumn

A compact, tuberous-rooted perennial with rosettes of broadly heart-shaped foliage, with silvery markings, from late winter to early summer. Double, orange flowers, with red-brown flushing on the reverse, and rather short stems, open from early spring

A compact, tuberous-rooted perennial with rosettes of broadly heart-shaped foliage flushed with dark purple, from late winter to early summer. Double, cream flowers, with grey flushing on the reverse, open from early spring

A bushy shrub to about 2m, with almost circular yellow foliage, flushed orange in spring and turning orange in autumn. Flowers consist of large sprays of tiny, pink and yellow blooms on green stems, followed by silvery-grey, wispy seedheads
A spreading evergreen shrub to 60cm high, with upright stems and small, scale-like, pale yellow-green leaves. Long spikes of small white flowers are produced in late summer and early autumn

An evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 74cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and creamy-yellow flowers with a violet-purple eyezone and green throat to 18cm across in summer

A clump-forming perennial, to around 90cm high in flower, with narrowly sword-shaped, slightly grey-green leaves. Flowers are velvety reddish purple, with short, ruffled standards, and broad falls with a yellow signal at the base

A rhizomatous, clump-forming, herbaceous perennial with upright, strap-like, dark green leaves and erect stems, growing to 50cm tall, bearing exquisite flowers with pink mottled, pale apricot upper petals, known as standards, and lusciously, deep orange-red lower petals, known as falls, with yellow veins

A compact, rosette-forming, evergreen perennial with spoon-shaped, toothed pale grey-green foliage with a silvery coating, and fragrant, pale, butter-yellow flowers with slightly darker centres, appearing in the spring

primary_name: Trillium chloropetalum var. giganteum EBG form

description: An elegant perennial forming a clump of long, narrow, evergreen, grass-like leaves, with tall, arching stems bearing nodding, pendant, bell-shaped, carmine red-pink flowers 4-6 cm long with tissue-thin frosted calyxes in summer

An evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 74cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and extremely large, red, spider-type flowers that have a green throat to 28cm across in early summer

A compact, bushy, clump-forming, herbaceous perennial up to 30cm when in flower, with narrow elliptic dark green leaves and open sprays of purple to purplish blue flower-heads with a yellow centre, in late summer to autumn

Deciduous shrub about 1.5m tall, grown for its attractive twisted and contorted stems. Produces heart-shaped, toothed mid-green leaves that turn yellow in autumn, and pendent yellow catkins in late winter and early spring followed by edible fruits in autumn

A bushy, clump-forming, tuberous perennial to around 70cm in height, with dark green serrated leaves. Fruity banana-yellow and pink watermelon flowers with recurved petals appear in July through until the first frosts

A semi-evergreen shrub with a distinctly upright habit, to 1.2m tall. It bears glossy leaves and in early spring produces clusters of slightly fragrant pink flowers; these are followed by spherical red fruits

A compact and bushy cultivar grown as an annual, bearing flowers from late spring through to the end of summer. Petals are white around the outside with a bluish-violet centre, held above narrow green leaves

Upright perennial coneflower, growing to 90cm tall with dark green leaves and bearing open, daisy-like flowers with dark pink ray petals surrounding a dark pinkish-orange central cone, blooming from summer through to autumn

A bulbous perennial to 70cm, producing a rosette of strap-shaped, wavy-edged, mid-green leaves lightly flushed with purple. In summer, dark red, upright stems carry dense spikes of greenish-white, star-shaped flowers, opening from pink buds, topped with a cluster of green, leaf-like bracts edged in purple. Purple seed pods follow

A bulbous perennial reaching a height of up to 50cm. It has green, strap-like leaves and erect stems with dense clusters of flowers which open from green buds into pure white flowers. These open from the bottom of the stems upwards from mid to late summer, and flowers last for several weeks. Excellent as a cut flower and in containers and a rich source of nectar.

primary_name: Helleborus (Rodney Davey Marbled Group) [Pippa's Purple] ('Rd09') (Frostkiss Series)
description: A semi-evergreen clump-forming perennial with divided, leathery, green and silvery, marbled foliage and branched stems rising above with dangling cup-shaped purple-pink single flowers with a central boss of pale yellow stamens in late winter and early spring.

A bushy, clump-forming, tuberous, deciduous herbaceous perennial with dark grey to sea-green serrated leaves and dark stems. Flower colour can range from apricot to burnt orange and these appear from July until the first frosts. Makes a good cut flower for vase displays and bouquets

A perennial bulb with broadly lance-shaped green leaves. This Triumph group tulip has pale purple flowers with reddish purple flaming, produced in mid to late spring. Flowers stand to around 55cm high

A compact, clump-forming, deciduous herbaceous perennial to 60cm, with deeply divided, glossy dark green leaves and erect dark, almost black stems bearing racemes of hooded, blue-purple flowers in late spring to early summer then again in late summer

A striking half-hardy gently spreading short-lived perennial grown mostly as an annual and used in seasonal summer displays. Bright orange fragrant starry blooms have a bold splash of yellow-gold at the base of each petal. The flowers are borne in profusion, covering the feathery mid-green to dark green foliage throughout summer and into early autumn. This modern cultivar stays neat and compact and is ideal for mixed containers, hanging baskets, patio pots, flower border edging and window boxes.

primary_name: Bidens 'Giant Yellow Red Tip' (Hawaiian Flare Series)

description: A compact, bushy perennial bedding plant with dark green, feathery foliage and single, star-shaped dark orange flowers with yellow-edged petals. Where as other varieties may become straggly over the season, this stays neat and compact and so makes an ideal plant for pots, containers and hanging baskets from summer through to autumn
A highly attractive, hardy annual with dark green foliage and bright white-yellow blooms with a dark red-brown centre that last from June to October. Perfect for cutting and container displays
An upright to spreading perennial to about 20cm with small, bright green leaves and spires of relatively large, rich purple-pink flowers from summer to early autumn
A compact, mounding annual with trailing stems and small pink flowers with white centres borne in profusion from summer into autumn
A large, clump-forming deciduous perennial with heart-shaped foliage with a creamy-white centre and wide feathery green margins. Upright stems of lavender-purple flowers appear in summer

A compact, clump-forming, decidous perennial with dark red stems bearing marrowly ovate to heart shaped mid-to dark green leaves, flushed, bronze to red in spring. Upright stems of fragrant purple to lavender flowers appear in the summer
A miniature, clump-forming deciduous perennial with variegated blue foliage and chartreuse-yellow margins. Upright stems of lavender-purple flowers appear in the summer

A compact, bushy, dwarf, evergreen shrub to 30cm with highly aromatic, dark grey-green leaves and terminal clusters of tiny, pale pink flowers in summer. The plant shown has been trained as a dwarf standard

A tuberous perennial, to about 45cm tall, with strap-shaped green, veined upright leaves clasping the stem. Red, purple or lilac orchid or iris-like flowers are produced over a long flowering period in loose clusters from July to September, giving an exotic touch if grown in pots
An upright perennial, to around 60cm high, with thin, lance-shaped green leaves. Rounded clusters of fragrant, magenta pink flowers with white centres are produced in summer

An intersectional or Itoh peony which is an upright and bushy herbaceous perennial with attractive dissected dark green foliage tinged red in spring. Short, erect stems holding showy, spicily scented, saucer-shaped bright scarlet red flowers with a centre of yellow stamens appear in summer. Flower stems are particularly short bringing the flowers just above the foliage.

A pretty, upright, perennial coneflower variety producing attractive blooms with long, narrow, white petals brushed pink at the centre, toothed at the ends, surrounding a prominent central brown-orange cone
A compact, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with glaucous green, scalloped foliage and tall stems forming a dense mass of bottlebrush dark magenta flower spikes in summer and early autumn

A low-growing perennial that forms neat, compact mounds of small, green, toothed lance-shaped foliage. Numerous, outward facing, vivid blue-violet, bell-shaped single flowers are borne on short stalks sitting just above its foliage providing a long flowering display in summer. An easy to grow plant that dislikes wet winters
A hardy, evergreen shrub to 10cm with bright green foliage foliage and white buds in summer and early autumn.
A low-growing, bud-flowering cultivar to 30cm tall with dark green foliage and pink-purple to pale purple flower buds in autumn
A hardy, evergreen shrub approximately 30cm tall with a spread to 35cm. It has light green, foliage and rose pink coloured buds from summer through to autumn.
A hardy, evergreen shrub with a creeping habit and dark green foliage. Violet coloured buds appear from summer through to autumn.
A hardy, evergreen shrub with a broad and upright habit, approximately 50cm tall with an equal spread to 50cm. It has green foliage and white buds that appear from summer through to autumn.
A hardy evergreen shrub with an upright habit approximately 30cm tall with a spread to 25cm. It has mid-green foliage and pink buds in summer through to autumn.

A clump-forming, evergreen to semi-evergreen fern with fronds that can reach up to 2m long on mature specimens and the frond leaflets (pinnae) are characteristically narrow. The young fronds vary in colour, sometimes green but often very intensely coloured carmine or orange. In late summer and early autumn small plantlets can often be seen on the mature frond upper surfaces.
An herbaceous perennial reaching approximately 90cm in height with linear strap-like leaves and spikes of coral red and lime flowers in summer and autumn.

An attractive, clump-forming, rhizomatous, herbaceous perennial with upright, strap-like, green leaves and erect stems bearing elegant, pink-purple flowers with yellow streaks and narrow, deep yellow beards
A large, clump-forming deciduous perennial with variegated yellow foliage and wide green margins. Upright stems of lavender-purple flowers appear in the summer
A semi-evergreen, upright, bushy perennial with aromatic green foliage and bright pink lipped flowers faintly tinted pink held on dark purple stems and calyces from summer through to autumn.

A semi-evergreen shrub to around 1m (3.2ft). Growth is upright, bushy with dark-green leaves that clasp the stems. In summer it produces bright yellow flowers with prominent stamens. These are followed in autumn by clusters of oval, red fruit which eventually mature to a rich mahogany-brown.

A compact, vigorous evergreen shrub to 1m high, with elliptic, glossy green leaves that are aromatic when crushed. Large clusters of very small, pale pink flowers open from deep reddish-purple buds in spring

alternative_names: African lily [Sea Storm]|Agapanthus praecox subsp. orientalis 'Atisea'
description: An evergreen, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-like mid-green leaves and sturdy stems which produce panicles of trumpet-shaped violet-blue flowers in summer, with a darker midrib down the centre of each petal

Compact, clump-forming perennial about 30cm tall, with dark green, lance-shaped leaves, and clusters of funnel-shaped pale creamy-yellow flowers which have flecks of green and dark brown streaks, flowering in summer and autumn
A decorative, clump-forming semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial with golden yellow foliage, and starry white flowers appearing in the spring and summer
A vigorous semi-evergreen cormous perennial, forming a clump of erect, lance-shaped foliage. Produces spikes of bowl-shaped soft pink flowers in autumn, to 60cm tall.

A compact, clump-forming semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial producing downy, bright lime-green foliage. Small, greenish-white flowers appear on tall, upright stems above the foliage during the summer

A clump-forming perennial to about 90cm tall, with succulent stems and bright, yellow foliage. In late spring and early summer produces arching, one-sided flower spikes bearing pendent heart-shaped flowers with white outer petals and small inner ones

A compact, clump-forming herbaceous perennial producing mounds of rounded, saw-edged, green-purple leaves with burgundy undersides. In summer crimson-coloured branched stems are topped by large, yellow-orange, daisy-like flowers held above the leaves. Height around 35cm (14in).
A densely-branched deciduous shub slowly reaching a height of around 1m. It is grown for its 5-petalled yellow and pale orange flowers, produced over many months. Extraordinarily resilient

A compact, clump-forming herbaceous perennial, to around 50cm high, with lance-shaped, slightly toothed, rough green leaves. Daisy-like flowers to 8cm across are produced from mid summer to autumn, with a dark brown central cone, a broad dark brown ring in the centre, and warm golden orange tips to the petals
An upright, perennial houseplant to around 1m, with smooth, fleshy, spear-like green-striped leaves. Mature plants may rarely produce upright spikes of fragrant, spidery, greenish-white flowers
A small and compact, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with glaucous green, scalloped foliage and slender stems forming a dense mass of small, red, oval flower spikes in summer and early autumn
A tuberous perennial with mid-green foliage and grows to about 90cm. The double flowers have pale pinkish-orange outer florets and a very full central dome of dark red, toothed inner florets

A large, upright, clump-forming, bushy tuberous perennial with serrated dark green leaves. White, frilly flowers with lilac-edged petals appear on upright stems from June though until the first frosts of autumn

A tuberous-rooted perennial to about 90cm, with mid-green foliage. Flowers, produced from mid-summer until the first frosts, have a single row of broad, rounded, pale peach outer petals, flushed dark purple-red at the base, an inner collar of short, narrow, white petals, and a central, yellow disc

A large-flowered gladiolus, height around 1m, with green sword like leaves and a flower spike with around 12-15 flower buds. The large flowers have a satin-like appearance and are pink with paler pink throats. Dramatic blooms for the summer garden
A giant-flowered gladiolus, 1.2m high, with green leaves and spikes of white flowers, eight to ten open at one time, from midsummer to late summer

A large-flowered gladiolus, maximum height 1.5m high, with green sword like leaves and flower spike with up to 10 flower buds, the large flowers have a velvet appearance and are a deep dark red with an edge of deeper dark almost black bordering the bloom
A clump-forming perennial daffodil to around 40cm high, with straplike, grey-green leaves. Flowers have white outer petals and a split, bright yellow corona almost covering the petals
A perennial bulb, to around 35cm high in flower, with broadly lance-shaped, grey-green leaves. Flowers are cup-shaped, with reddish petals with soft apricot edges. Early flowering

A perennial bulb to around 40cm, with broadly lance-shaped dark green foliage and strong stems. Double, bowl-shaped, peony-like, fragrant orange flowers, tinged with green on the outer petals, reveal bright yellow centres when fully open, and appear in April

A taller, clump-forming, deciduous herbaceous perennial with strap-like leaves and very sturdy stems producing umbels of trumpet-shaped flowers in the summer which are very pale blue, almost white in colour.

A woody-based perennial herb, forming a spreading clump to around 40cm high, with slender, reddish stems and oval-shaped, aromatic yellow-green leaves. Clusters of lilac pink tubular flowers are produced at the tips of the stems in summer

A clump-forming perennial to about 30cm high, forming a mound of large, lobed, silvery leaves with dark purple undersides. Loose sprays of small white flowers open from pale pink buds, held on short stems above the foliage in summer

primary_name: Rubus fruticosus agg. [Lowberry Little Black Prince] (B)
alternative_names: blackberry [Lowberry Little Black Prince]|blackberry 'Little Black Prince'|Rubus idaeus 'Little Black Prince'
description: An ever-bearing (fruiting on 1 and 2-year old stems), compact-growing blackberry reaching 1m. It has green leaves on thornless stems and has small white or pale pink flowers which produce a harvest for 3 or 4 months.

A clump-forming, deciduous grass, to 1.2m tall, with narrow, arching leaves, red flushed in spring, becoming olive green in summer, then bronze-red in autumn, fading to pale brown in winter. Feathery flower panicles open silvery-pink in late summer and early autumn, fading to silver and remaining on the plant over winter

A clump-forming, herbaceous perennial, rare in cultivation, to around 150cm in height, with divided dark green foliage which becomes dormant in dry conditions. Vibrant, lavender-blue flower heads appear in summer, making it much more distinguishable from other, similar forms of Dipsacus. Great for attracting pollinators and the dried seedheads over winter are an excellent source of food for birds

Deciduous climber to about 3.5m tall, with dark green leaves and bearing very large, dark purple-red flowers to 15cm across, on long stems, with dark purple central bars and pale yellow anthers, produced from early or midsummer into autumn

A compact, hardy, bushy, deciduous shrub with a lax habit and variegated grey-green foliage with a creamy edge, flushed pink when young. Single, cerise pink flowers with a purple corolla appear from summer through until the autumn
A compact, clump-forming variety with purple silvery-grey leaves. Upright stems produce panicles of small bell-shaped, red to pink flowers from late spring to early summer
A dense, clump-forming perennial with large, dark charcoal grey-veined, rosy-purple leaves. During the Summer, rosy-pink flowers are borne on upright stems from dark rose coloured buds.

A clump-forming, semi-evergreen perennial bearing lobed, bright green / yellow leaves, marked dark bronze to red in the centre. Slender stems bear panicles tiny, bell-shaped, creamy flowers from late spring into summer.

An evergreen perennial to 30cm, forming a dense mound of deeply lobed, serrated foliage opening dark bronzy-orange with a dark red centre, becoming dark green in summer. Small, white, star-shaped flowers are produced in airy spires on fine, upright stems in mid-summer

A clump-forming, semi-evergreen perennial, to around 25cm high, with lobed, glossy dark purple leaves that appear almost black. Slender stems bear clusters of tiny, bell-shaped white flowers in early summer

A clump-forming, semi-evergreen perennial with deeply lobed, red / purple leaves, darker at the veins. Slender stems bear open panicles of tiny, bell-shaped, white flowers from late spring into summer.

alternative_names: three-spine barberry 'Cally Rose'|Berberis panlanensis 'Cally Rose'|Berberis sanguinea 'Cally Rose'
description: A striking and showy small to medium-sized evergreen shrub with quite an informal habit. Very fine, narrow lance-shaped dark green leaves, and clusters of unusual flowers that have pink-red petals with whitish-green centres in spring, are followed by dark blue-black berries by autumn

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 89cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and pale cream-apricot flowers that have a feathered rose-coloured eye-zone above a yellow-green throat to 10cm across in summer. This variety also flowers at night.

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 71cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and large lavender-pink flowers that have a purple-black eye and edge to 15cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 66cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and melon-peach coloured flowers that have a purple eye-zone above a yellow throat to 10cm across in summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 76cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and large, unusually shaped, violet-purple coloured flowers that have darker purple veins above a green throat to 20cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 79cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and rose-red coloured flowers that have a ruby-red eye-zone with a black and red edge above a green throat to 17cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 79cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and bold red flowers to 18cm across that have a paler red eye-zone, a yellow ruffled edge and yellow-green throat in summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 81cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and baby-pink coloured flowers that have a yellow, ruffled edge above a lime-green throat to 15cm across in summer

A sparsely branching deciduous shrub with finely dissected, deep green leaves that are flushed red on opening. Very large, cream-coloured flowers, with a faint pink blush and small dark pink flares at the base, are produced in late spring and early summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 71cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and fragrant, pink flowers that have a gold ruffled edge and throat to 14cm across in summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 74cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and large, fragrant, unusual, wavy-edged, pale-lavender coloured flowers that have a large, pale yellow throat to 17cm across in summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 66cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and creamy green-white flowers with a complex greenish-pink-grey eye-zone above a deep green throat to 12cm across in summer

An evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 81cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and very large, unusual wavy-edged, lemon-yellow coloured flowers that have a rose-red coloured eye-zone above a green throat to 22cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 94cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and fragrant, icy-blue-lavender coloured flowers that have a diamond-dusted speckled pattern with a darker lavender-purple halo to 23cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 76cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and rose-pink coloured flowers that have a variable striped pattern above a yellow throat to 15cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 99cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and lavender-purple coloured, patterned flowers with a chartreuse-green throat to 15cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 89cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and unusual, wavy-edged, dark purple flowers that have a darker purple eye-zone and a patterned green throat to 18cm across in summer

An evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 91cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and extremely large, dark red-purple flowers with a green throat to 28cm across in summer

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 71cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and lavender-pink coloured flowers that have a darker pink eye-band above a green throat to 13cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 66cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and fragrant, peach coloured flowers with a peach-gold coloured throat to 15cm across in summer. The flowers remain open for longer than 16 hours

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 104cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves, and very large and fragrant, rose-pink coloured flowers that have a pale pink watermark and fine white edge, above a yellow-green throat to 25cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 84cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and candy-pink coloured flowers with a deep green throat to 13cm across in summer.

An herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 97cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and fragrant, striking, red-and-white striped flowers with a green throat to 12cm across in summer.

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 107cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and unusual, bright orange-red flowers to 17cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 76cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like, green leaves and fragrant, nocturnal, rose-pink flowers that have creamy-white irregular stripes above a yellow-green throat to 14cm across in summer

A semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 16cm in height. It forms clumps of arching strap-shaped green leaves and pink, veined and slightly ruffled flowers, a whiteish midrib and large green throat to 19cm across in summer

A deciduous, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 89cm in height. It forms clumps of arching strap-shaped green leaves and curled and twisted lavender-purple flowers with paler sepals and a yellow throat to 25cm across in summer
A deciduous, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped, arching mid-green leaves and sturdy stems of purple-pink flowers, darker towards the centre, with a yellow-green throat

A semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 71cm in height. It forms clumps of arching strap-shaped green, sometimes variegated leaves and yellow flowers with a slightly toothed edge above a green throat to 13cm across in summer. Buds are often half green and half white
A semi-evergreen, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped, arching mid-green foliage and pale purple to dark pink flowers with a large green yellow eye. Some petals are slightly reflexed
A deciduous, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped, arching mid-green foliage and sturdy stems of large, single, showy bright pink flowers with a large, bright green throat
A semi-evergreen, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped, arching mid-green foliage and sturdy stems of large, reflexed single dark pink flowers with a yellow-green throat

A semi-evergreen herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 94cm in height when in flower. It forms a clump of arching, strap-like green leaves and rich purple flowers with white edges and a paler smoky-purple watermark, and yellow-green throats to 13cm across in summer

A evergreen, clump-forming herbaceous perennial with strap-shaped, arching mid-green leaves and sturdy stems of pink to pale orange flowers, with a pale yellow stripe down the centre of each petal and a frilly gold edge

Compact, clump-forming perennial about 35cm tall, with mid-green, lance-shaped leaves. and clusters of greenish-white buds opening to pure-white funnel-shaped flowers, occasionally with green flushes, and dark purple speckles on the inner petals, flowering in summer and autumn

A low growing perennial that forms neat, compact mounds of small, green, toothed lance-shaped foliage. Numerous, outward facing, pure white, bell-shaped single flowers are borne on short stalks sitting just above its foliage providing a long flowering display in summer. An early flowering cultivar and easy to grow plant that dislikes wet winters
Dense, clump-forming, evergreen perennial sedge, 30-45cm tall, with bright, rich green leaves. Carries pale greenish-brown flower spikes within the foliage, during summer
A low-growing, evergreen perennial, to around 15cm high, with narrow, deep green leaves. Produces fragrant, cherry red flowers with white centres and fine white edges, from late spring into summer

A compact, clump-forming perennial, up to 50cm high, with leafy, branching stems and dark green foliage. Flowers have dark orange to yellow petals surrounding a large brown central cone, and are produced from midsummer into autumn

An evergreen, mound-forming, woody-based perennial or sub-shrub to around 30cm high, with narrow, glossy green leaves. Masses of rounded clusters of small white flowers with tiny yellow centres are produced from late spring to early summer

A bulbous perennial, to around 1m high, with upright stems and lance-shaped, dark green leaves. Large, fragrant, double white flowers with lightly ruffled edges are produced in mid to late summer. Double oriental lilies such as this have extra petals rather than anthers, so are pollen-free

Slow-growing, large, dense, evergreen shrub about 3-4m tall and wide with upright sturdy stems. Leathery leaves to 10cm long are grey-green with irregular golden-yellow margins and large clusters of small, very sweetly-scented creamy-white flowers produced in late spring and early summer turn yellow with age
A densely-branched deciduous shub reaching 60cm. It is grown for its 5-petalled pink flowers with yellow centre, produced over many months. Extraordinarily resilient

A succulent, evergreen sub-shrub forming a mound of closely-packed leaf rosettes on stems to 50cm tall. The leaves are are green at the centre of the rosette, darkening to deep red on the outer whorls. Domed clusters of small, starry yellow flowers are sometimes produced in late spring. A good patio plant, but is best moved under glass where winters are not reliably mild

primary_name: Delosperma cooperi [Jewel of Desert Amethyst] ('Dsam131') (Jewel of Desert Series)

description: A fast-growing, tender evergreen perennial climber, often grown as an annual, with green heart shaped leaves. Dark orange flowers with a red centres appear in summer and autumn
A bushy annual vegetable which will reach 1m. It has green leaves and purple or white flowers, which develop into a heavy crop of egg-shaped white fruits - sometimes with a slightly ribbed shape.
A compact bushy annual vegetable small enough to be grown in a pot on a patio. It has green leaves and purple flowers, which develop into a heavy crop of small egg-shaped dark purple fruits

A compact easy-to-grow annual vegetable small enough to be grown in a pot on a patio. It has green leaves and purple flowers, which develop into a heavy crop of small egg-shaped dark purple to almost black fruits

An epiphytic plant with a swollen, semi-succulent stem (known as a caudex), which is sometimes ridged or spiny. This is made up of cavities or tunnels that evolved in its native environment to host colonies of ants. Leathery, elliptic green leaves are held on pale fleshy stalks and often crowded around the tip of the stem. Small white flowers are produced directly from the main stem, followed by fleshy orange-red berries

A clump-forming perennial daffodil with grey-green, strap-shaped leaves. Flowers from early to mid spring, producing solitary, double triangle shaped flowers to 9cm across, with broad white outer petals and a large, funnel-shaped yellow cup with an toothed rim
An erect, rhizomatous perennial to 50m tall, with stiff, fleshy leaves, tapering to a point. Each leaf bears pronounced light and dark green bands

This ‘Nantes’ type variety can be grown as a second early or maincrop. Carrots have smooth skin, a uniform, cylindrical shape with a blunt end, good orange colour and most importantly is considered to have a delicious flavour. This variety was bred for carrot fly resistance but isn’t immune to attacks, so if there are carrot fly around and this is the only carrot crop nearby it may still get attacked. For this reason, it might be worth considering growing a sacrificial carrot or still using netting

A biennial grown as an annual vegetable, producing bright green, feathery foliage and sweet, smooth-skinned, uniform, cylindrical carrots. This is a maincrop cultivar for harvesting in late summer and autumn; also suitable for storing over winter

alternative_names: courgette 'British Summertime'|courgette 'Best of British'|Cucurbita pepo 'Best of British'
description: An early British bred courgette variety producing high yields of dark green fruits on spine-free stems. It is one of the earliest varieties to set fruit and can be harvested between July and October

primary_name: Capsicum annuum var. annuum (Grossum Group) 'Takii's Ace'
alternative_names: sweet pepper 'Takii's Ace'|sweet pepper 'Ace'|Capsicum annuum var. annuum (Grossum Group) 'Ace'

description: A vigorous, dense and bushy evergreen shrub. Its upright branches bear glossy green leaves, the new shoots are a striking bright golden green and become darker with age. Upright spikes of small white flowers appear in May and these are followed by clusters of black berries in Autumn

alternative_names: white willow 'Hutchinson's Yellow Bark'|Salix × rubens 'Hutchinsons Yellow'|Salix alba 'Hutchinson's Yellow'
description: A large deciduous tree, with a conical habit, slender branches and vivid yellow new shoots, Leaves are narrowly lance-shaped, and covered with silky hairs, making them look silvery from a distance. Slender catkins are produced alongside the new leaves in spring

An evergreen succulent, with a very short stem producing a cluster of fleshy, finger-like, mid-green leaves, with a patchy, white, woolly covering. In summer, may produce a few, yellow, daisy-like flowers on thin, upright stems
A deciduous shrub which slowly grows to 1.5m tall. It has green leaves and in early summer followed again in early autumn, it has many clusters of fragrant, light purple flowers
A compact, upright, bushy deciduous shrub with fresh green foliage and panicles of small fragrant tubular white flowers in spring and summer
A deciduous shrub which slowly grows to 1.5m tall. It has green leaves and in early summer followed again in early autumn, it has many clusters of fragrant, light pink flowers
A perennial bulb to around 50cm high, with broadly strap-like grey-green leaves. Unusually shaped white flowers, the petals being concave before flaring at the tips appear from mid to late spring

A deciduous climber, to around 3m high, with divided, mid-green leaves. Flat, deep red flowers, up to 10cm across, open from long pointed buds in mid to late summer, and are followed by persistent seedheads
A compact, deciduous tuberous-rooted perennial, to about 45cm, with dark stems and green foliage. Vibrant double red flowers are produced from mid-summer to the first frosts
A tender, evergreen perennial, with large green leaves held on slender stems. Leaves are pale whitish green on the upper surface, with dark green streaks from the midrib to the margin

primary_name: Crocus neapolitanus old clone from Oxford Botanic Garden
alternative_names: Crocus vernus old clone from Oxford Botanic Garden
Crocus heuffelianus subsp. heuffelianus 'Dark Eyes'|Crocus vernus subsp. vernus (Heuffelianus Group) 'Dark Eyes'
Crocus 'Carpathian Wonder'|Crocus heuffelianus subsp. heuffelianus 'Carpathian Wonder'|Crocus vernus subsp. vernus (Heuffelianus Group) 'Carpathian Wonder'
