plant_range: W Canada to W Central USA

description: Fls 9 per stem, rounded, 35-38mm wide; perianth segments roundish, very broad, blunt, scarcely mucronate, white, spreading or somewhat reflexed, plane or with margins incurved, smooth and of heavy substance, overlapping half; the inner segments narrower, ovate, more nearly spreading; corona bowl-shaped, smooth, lemon yellow, touched green at base, mouth expanded, lightly ribbed, a little wavy, shallowly and irregularly lobed, with rim crenate. Autumn. Blooms late autumn to very early winter; robust plant; offsets on large bulbs will produce a second stem, good for lengthening flowering period. Collected from an old garden in Natchez, Mississippi, USA

Fl. forming a double triangle, 120mm wide, facing upwards; perianth segments 50mm long, very broadly ovate, blunt, mucronate, greenish white 157D, spreading, plane, with margins incurved, creased and of membranaceous substance, overlapping half; corona 40mm long, funnel-shaped, ribbed, orange-pink (29C), becoming orange-pink (27C) towards base, mouth straight and frilled, with rim flanged and crenate. Mid-season. Sweetly scented

alternative_names: magnolia 'Eileen Baines'|Magnolia wilsonii 'Eileen Baines'|Magnolia wilsonii 'Richgain'|Magnolia sinensis 'Eileen Baines'
description: A large, bushy deciduous shrub to 6m in height, with narrowly-ovate dark green leaves to 18cm long, downy beneath. Large, nodding, cup-shaped, heavily-scented, pure white double flowers, with rich-crimson stamens are produced in late spring and early summer, with another flush of flower in late summer

Fl. rounded, 105mm wide, facing upwards; perianth and other petaloid segments in several whorls, greenish white 150D, touched vivid yellow 4A along margins at base; the outer whorls 40mm long, broadly ovate, blunt, slightly mucronate, spreading, plane or with margins incurved, with midrib showing, creased and of membranaceous substance, overlapping half or more; the inner whorls successively shorter and more strongly inflexed towards centre, folded or strongly wavy, scarcely mucronate; corona segments 30mm long, in several whorls, vivid yellow 9A; outer whorls interspersed among inner perianth segments; inner whorls clustered at centre, frilled and minutely crenate. Mid-season. Strongly scented

Fls 6-9 per stem, rounded, 28mm wide; perianth segments roundish, very broad, blunt, prominently mucronate, opening lemon yellow, becoming pale sulphur yellow at maturity, spreading or somewhat reflexed, shallowly concave, creased and of membranaceous substance, overlapping half or more; the inner segments more nearly plane; corona shallow cup to bowl-shaped, smooth, golden yellow, mouth straight and even, with rim minutely crenate. Autumn. Resembles ‘Minnow’ but is pale yellow and blooms in late autumn Collected from an old garden in Natchez, Mississippi. Seed fertile

alternative_names: Egyptian mimosa|Egyptian thorn|gum arabic|gum arabic tree|Acacia nilotica subsp. tomentosa|Acacia arabica

description: A low-growing, clump-forming rhizomatous perennial to around 50cm high, with basal rosettes of lobed and toothed green leaves. Prolific, long-lasting, semi-double bright, fiery red flowers are held on stems above the foliage from May to July then produce a second flush of blooms in the autumn. Tolerant of sun or part shade
A low-growing, spreading evergreen shrub to around 20cm in height with linear dark green leaves. Delicate-looking, single, salmon-pink flowers with yellow centres appear in late spring to summer

A medium-sized superb clump-forming, deciduous perennial to around 50-60cm in height, with bright yellow rounded leaves and red stems that stand out from the crowd. Pale purple flowers bloom in summer

A vigorous, clump-forming, deciduous perennial with thick, puckered golden yellow-green foliage with a wide green border. The golden-yellow colour becomes more intense as the green fades over the season. Upright stems of white flowers appear in summer

An upright, clump-forming deciduous perennial to around 25-30cm in height, with white oval leaves bordered with a blue-green margin. The red stems really set off the variegated leaves, making this little Miss stand out in a border. Purple flowers bloom in summer
A clump-forming deciduous perennial with variegated green foliage with wavy yellow margins and pointed tips. Upright stems of lavender purple-pink flowers appear in summer

A relatively upright, medium-sized deciduous tree to a height of between 8 and 12m with a moderately-spreading crown. Dark green leaves with serrated edges appear in the spring, turning to a buttery yellow colour in the autumn. Pure white, smooth bark peels from the tree to add further interest all year round. Provides ghostly impact when planted together against a dark background
A large, clump-forming deciduous perennial with ridged green-yellow foliage with wavy edges, pointed at the tips. Upright stems of lavender-purple flowers appear in summer
A small, clump-forming deciduous perennial with narrow, oval-shaped blue-green foliage, pointed at the tips. Upright stems of lavender pink-purple flowers appear in summer

A clump-forming deciduous perennial with yellow green leaves and red stems. The leaves contrast wonderfully with the purple flowers as they bloom over the summer. Height 40-45cm and spread 50-60cm. The leaves are quite thick for a yellow cultivar which help to discourage the slugs

plant_range: Nepal to SE Asia and China

description: A clump-forming deciduous perennial to around 50-60cm in height, with large green leaves, wavy white margins and deep prominent veins. Upright stems of pale lavender flowers appear in the summer
A compact, mound-forming evergreen shrub with dark green leaves. Double, peach-pink flowers appear from June through to August

alternative_names: Dahlia 'Castillo' (Dalina Grande Series)|Dahlia 'Castillo' (Dalina Maxi Series)|Dahlia 'Maxi Castilo'

description: Stem height 1.8m (tall). Foliage mid-green, standard elatum form. Spikes 80mm long, tapering to apex. Lateral spikes 3 to 5 of average vigour. Flowers semi-double, 70-75mm wide; petals violet blue (A89) with outer petals becoming blue (A99) at maturity; eye colour off white, hairs yellow. Mid to late flowering. Etym: named for registrant's daughter

A compact, clump-forming deciduous perennial, to a height of around 40cm, with rounded, heart-shaped, green leaves with irregular blue-green margins splashed around the leaf. Pale lavender flowers bloom in the summer

A clump-forming deciduous perennial with green wavy leaves which open as yellow when they appear in early spring. The stems are red and the lavender coloured flowers bloom in summer. The red, gold and green Hosta has a height of 40-45 cm

A clump-forming, bushy tuberous perennial with dark green serrated leaves. Large, white decorative form flowers, brushed with lilac-pink and with a hint of yellow, appear from summer until the first frosts
A small, clump-forming deciduous perennial with oval-shaped, slightly wavy and corrugated pale green foliage with pointed tips. Upright stems of lavender pink-purple flowers appear in summer

plant_range: India to SE Asia and China

description: A tender, deciduous tuberous perennial to 30cm, with trailing red stems and pale green, dissected leaves. Abundant orange flowers appear from summer into early autumn. Ideal for a range of situations including patio pots and containers, hanging baskets and as a houseplant

A bushy, deciduous herbaceous perennial with upright stems, woody at the base, and large, dark green foliage. Large, caramel brown to honey yellow flowers, with a pink and white eye appear from July through to September

A clump-forming evergreen perennial which initially has an upright habit, quickly changing to trailing as it grows. Pointed, hairy, oval foliage is variegated green to purple with silver stripes. Additional stripes can also be random in cream, yellow, white or pink

An upright, evergreen, fast-growing palm to 5m tall with a stout trunk covered with a thick layer of pale fibres. The trunk is topped by a head of green, fan-like leaves comprising deeply split leaflets 80-100cm long that are held stiffly erect on the ends of petioles 1-1.2min length. Clusters of pale yellow flowers appear in summer. Hardy in the UK and an excellent palm for adding a tropical feel to a garden

A clump-forming evergreen perennial with oval, grey-green foliage, which initially has an upright habit, quickly changing to trailing. It will stay compact and upright for a longer period in bright light but trail more quickly if exposed to less light. Pale purple flowers with yellow anthers may appear any time of the year

A bushy, deciduous herbaceous perennial with upright stems, woody at the base, and large, dark green foliage. Large, rich orange flowers with a lavender-mauve centre and dark red eye appear from July through to September

A bushy, deciduous herbaceous perennial with upright stems, woody at the base, and large, dark green foliage. Large, strawberry-pink flowers with a darker pinkish-red eye and apricot edges appear from July through to September

A bushy, deciduous herbaceous perennial with upright stems, woody at the base, and large, dark green foliage. Large, rich golden yellow flowers with a pinkish-purple eye appear from July through to September
A climbing floridunda rose which grows to 2m tall. It has pink flowers which age to apricot, from summer into autumn

A clump-forming deciduous perennial with an upright vase habit. The leaves open out as stunning white with a blue-green margin. The margins and central leaf become greener as it sails though the growing season, with masts of lavender flowers appearing in summer. Height 30cm and a spread of 60cm

A wide-spreading, clump-forming deciduous perennial to around 70-80cm in height, with large, blue-green rounded leaves, with a dark green margin which brightens through the season. Spikes of pale lavender flowers to 1.2m in height appear in summer

An evergreen tree with greyish-green leaves and fruits which are eaten as a table olive. It is only partially self-fertile so will do much better with a pollination partner, but its large, fleshy olives are green and harvested early. It copes better than others in slightly colder regions but does not tolerate wind

A compact, low-growing, mat-forming hardy evergreen perennial up to 15cm in height, forming a colourful, spreading carpet of green, finger-shaped succulent foliage which may develop reddish-purple tints in lower light levels. Soft, pale-orange, daisy-like flowers with a subtle pink blush appear from April to June. Great as ground cover, in rock gardens or in containers and drought and heat-tolerant

alternative_names: Engler's abelia|Abelia koehneana|Abelia kweichowensis|Abelia longituba|Abelia engleriana
description: A semi-evergreen shrub with somewhat arching stems and mid-green foliage, the undersides of which, along with juvenile growth, is tinged bronze. The abundant funnel-shaped, lilac-pink flowers have an eye-catching streak of golden-yellow on the lower petal and throat. Flowers are produced from early to late summer

An evergreen perennial with silvery blue leaves, 20-25cm in height and with a spread of 30-60cm. Produces masses of velvety, semi double blooms of rich red, the petals finely serrated with a defining white edge. A very versatile ground cover that can reflower in autumn if you shear off the flowers soon after the summer flowering

An upright, strong and bushy tender evergreen perennial with rounded, dark green leaves with wavy edges. Clusters of large, pure white double flowers on sturdy stems appear in summer. Ideal for pots, containers and hanging baskets
A perennial bulb with broadly lance-shaped green foliage and tall, strong stems to around 45cm. Dark, cerise-pink to purple single flowers, with a hint of red, appear in late April
A perennial bulb to around 50cm, with light green, lance-shaped foliage. Tall stems of crown-shaped flowers in shades of pink, with a cream base, appear April to May

primary_name: Galanthus plicatus 'Dryad Leto' (Myths and Legends Series)
description: A compact, clump-forming, bulbous perennial to around 8cm in height with broadly arching, strap-shaped, greyish-green leaves. White, honey-scented, cone-shaped flowers with green, heart-shaped markings appear in late winter
A perennial bulb to around 50cm, with light green, lance-shaped foliage. Tall stems of crown-shaped, red flowers, with a creamy-yellow edge, appear from April to May

A deciduous, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 60cm in height when in flower. It produces a clump of green, arching strap-like leaves and an abundance of rounded heads of tubular, dark blue flowers with darker midribs from mid-summer to autumn

A mound-forming, deciduous perennial to around 55cm in height, with large, blue-green leaves with a wide margin of white lapping around the leaf. These eye-catching leaves have prominent veins and remain textured throughout the summer. The glorious margin emerges as a creamy yellow band and matures to white in the summer, when the purple flowers will join the show
test
A vigorous, annual climber, up to around 2.5m high, with curling tendrils and pairs of green leaves. Fragrant, bi-colour pale mauve to blue flowers appear from June to September

A semi-evergreen biennial or short-lived perennial, to 100cm high in flower, with a basal rosette of hairy dark green leaves. Tall spikes of sterile, tubular white flowers appear from June through to October, flowering longer than other varieties

A compact, bushy, herbaceous perennial to 70cm tall, with aromatic dark foliage. Purple-pink flowers with a mass of narrow petals and a mauve central cone, above dull purple bracts, appear from summer through to autumn

A bulbous perennial to around 25-30cm tall with grey-green leaves. White flowers have 6, pure white outer segments held outwards like a parasol, with no inner segments. The flowers are 4cm across and the leaves only reach halfway up the flower stem, creating an eye-catching display

A compact, clump-forming, deciduous perennial with bright golden yellow veined foliage and wavy margins. Foliage is at its brightest in the spring. Upright stems of large, pale lavender-purple flowers appear in summer

A clump-forming, deciduous perennial with wavy yellow leaves which mature to green, and the dark purple stems complement the lavender flowers that appear in summer. Height 35-40cm and a spread of 40-50cm

A vigorous, annual climber, up to around 1.8m high, with curling tendrils and pairs of green leaves. Fragrant, pure white flowers with frilly petals appear in summer. Very floriferous, producing up to 6 florets per stem
A compact, deciduous shrub to around 1m, with oval-shaped, dark green serrated foliage. Large, conical panicles of lime-green flowers emerge in summer, turning to purple in the autumn

A clump-forming deciduous perennial with a sassy and fruity colour combination of heart-shaped, yellow leaves with a bright green margin and red stems. Height 30-35cm and spread of 40-45cm. Upright stems of purple flowers appear in the summer

A deciduous shrub to 2.5m high, with arching stems and bright green, ovate leaves that turn orange-red in autumn. Produces clusters of red buds that open to scented white flowers in late spring and early summer
A compact, clump-forming, rhizomatous herbaceous perennial with sword-shaped grey-green leaves. Purple flowers with white and golden yellow centres appear in the summer
A hardy, deciduous shrub with oval-shaped, very dark green foliage. Large, dense panicles of pale, lime-green flowers appear from June through to October

A compact, semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 50cm in height when in flower. It produces a clump of green, arching strap-like leaves and an abundance of rounded heads of tubular, pale lilac-blue flowers with darker midribs from mid-summer to autumn

A clump-forming, deciduous perennial to around 40cm in height, with blue-green ruffled leaves, variegated with creamy-yellow margins. Mature clumps can have a spread of up to 1.2m. Upright stems of pale lavender flowers appear in mid to late summer

A tufted, deciduous grass to 70cm height, with blue-grey linear leaves which turn brown or sometimes orange-red in the autumn. Slender stems bear a few one-sided, horizontal, comb-like greenish-yellow flower spikes, turning to straw-yellow in summer. These turn to blonde seed heads which remain on the stems through autumn and early winter. An interesting choice for edging a sunny path or in pots and containers
A compact, deciduous shrub to 1m, with oval-shaped, dark green foliage. Large, conical lime-green flowers appear from July to September, turning to shades of pink and red as they mature

alternative_names: abelia [Bridal Bouquet]|Zabelia tyaihyonii 'Monia'|Abelia mosanensis [Bridal Bouquet]|Abelia mosanensis 'Monia'
description: A deciduous shrub to 1.5m in height with an arching habit and mid-green glossy oval-shaped leaves. A profusion of scented white, trumpet-shaped flowers open from pink buds and bloom over a long period over spring and summer. This cultivar has good orange-red autumn colour

alternative_names: Spanish dagger 'Mellow Yellow'|Yucca gloriosa var. recurvifolia 'Mellow Yellow'

description: A clump-forming deciduous perennial to a height of 25cm, with heart-shaped leaves of vivid blue and a waxy coating which gives them a long-lasting, silvery finish. Upright stems of lavender flowers appear in mid-summer

A small, mound-forming deciduous perennial to around 25-35cm in height, with a fun clump of long, thin, wavy leaves of zesty yellow, contrasting wonderfully with the dark purple flowers held up high in summer. This life and soul of the party is relatively slug resistant and sun tolerant

alternative_names: Abelia serrata var. tomentosa|Abelia serrata var. hirsuta

description: A bushy, compact, herbaceous perennial to 70cm tall, with aromatic, dark green foliage. Rose-pink flowers with a mass of narrow petals and a mauve central cone, above dull purple bracts, appear from July through to October. High mildew resistance and performs well if planted in partial shade

A clump-forming deciduous perennial to a height of around 60cm with large, heart-shaped green leaves. The emerging leaves are grey-green with a waxy coating which washes off over time and reveals a large clump of glossy green foliage. The pale lavender flowers bloom in early summer. A lovely large Hosta for creating lush drifts of foliage

alternative_names: Linnaea borealis subsp. occidentalis|Linnaea borealis subsp. americana

description: A clump-forming deciduous perennial with large, heart-shaped, beautiful blue leaves with yellow margins changing to creamy white as the season progresses. Height of 60-70cm and spread of 80-90cm. Upright stems of lavender flowers bloom in the summer

An upright, strong and bushy tender evergreen perennial with rounded, dark green leaves with wavy edges. Clusters of large, red, double flowers on sturdy stems appear in summer. Ideal for pots, containers and hanging baskets

A small, clump-forming, deciduous perennial, to around 15cm in height, with rounded green leaves, yellow margins and splashes of white where the yellow meets the green centre, giving this little Hosta a very funky appearance. Stout little stems of lavender flowers appear in mid-summer

A small, bushy, deciduous shrub oval green leaves, tapering towards the ends. Young growth is bronze in colour and the scented clusters of trumpet-shaped flowers are white with orange markings inside. They bloom from mid spring to early summer

A clump-forming, deciduous perennial to around 40cm in height, with striking streaked leaves. The wavy and corrugated green foliage is marked with dashes of yellow and white. Upright stems of lavender flowers appear in the summer. This zesty cultivar can be a little unstable and prone to reversion, plant in dapple shade or morning sun for best colour and remove reversion when you divide

A semi-evergreen, herbaceous perennial that reaches approximately 50cm in height when in flower. It produces a clump of green, arching strap-like leaves and an abundance of rounded heads of tubular, white flowers which develop a pink blush as they age, from mid-summer to autumn

A clump-forming deciduous perennial to around 30-60cm in height, with cascading blue leaves with wavy edges all the way to the pointed tip, like a waterfall in leaf form. Pale purple flowers tower above the leaves in summer
A vigorous, annual climber, up to around 2.5m high, with curling tendrils and pairs of green leaves. Neat, fragrant maroon-red and purple-blue flowers appear from June to September

A fast-growing large shrub or small tree with dark purple-red foliage which, unlike other cultivars, remains this colour throughout the season. Pink catkins appear in spring, followed by edible nuts in the autumn which have attractive fringed red husks
A bulbous perennial to around 45cm in height with green foliage. Tall stems of single, reflexed, pointed, lily-like pink flowers, flushed with darker pink, appear from April to May
A vigorous, annual climber, up to around 2.5m high, with curling tendrils and pairs of green leaves. Large, fragrant, frilly pink flowers appear on long stems from June to September
A deciduous shrub to 1m, with dark green serrated foliage on branching stems. Large, dense, conical-shaped clusters of lemon-white flowers appear in summer
A perennial bulb to 45cm with green foliage and large, peachy-orange flowers appearing in April to May
A dense, compact, evergreen shrub to around 70cm in height, with oval-shaped, glossy dark green leaves. Masses of funnel-shaped, pink flowers appear in the spring

A dessert apple with dainty white spring flowers, followed by sweet, white, crisp, juicy and aromatic fruit with purple-white blushed skin. Fruits are ready to harvest in late autumn, and can be eaten straight from the tree or stored for several months. Pollination Group 3

A clump-forming, herbaceous perennial to 60cm tall, with dark green, hairy, aromatic foliage. Dark pink-purple flowers with a crown of pink florets and a darker centre appear from summer through to autumn

An upright, tuberous perennial to around 50cm, with green, lance-shaped leaves which occasionally have a burgundy underside. The three-petalled blooms are deep red to purple in colour with a crinkly texture, and appear in spring

An arching, clump-formi,ng deciduous perennial with blue-green leaves and wide, creamy-white margins. The foliage is rippled and corrugated, providing an eye-catching texture. Mature plants reach heights of 40-50cm and spreads to 1.1m. Pale lavender flowers bloom in July and August, on stems of up to 90cm

A compact, clump-forming deciduous perennial to a height of around 10-15cm with small, pointed green leaves. This miniature hosta has upright stems of lavender flowers appearing in the summer. Perfect for a pot or a little shady spot

An upright, mound-forming deciduous perennial with slightly twisted wavy yellow leaves which cascade out of the center of the clump and mature to a soft green in summer. The long purple leaf stems are a wonderful feature, holding the leaves to a height of 45-55 cm and spread of 96cm. The lavender flowers are held aloft on stems of up to 80cm in summer

A low-growing, mat-forming, perennial succulent with rounded, dark green leaves which turn dark red as the season progresses. Bright, rosy-pink flowers appear in the summer. Drought tolerant and great for ground cover
